steps: Call an ambulance (1122) immediately for a large, deep, electrical, or facial burn.
Run cool, clean water over the burn for 20 minutes; remove tight jewellery or clothing nearby.
Cover loosely with a sterile non-stick dressing and do not apply ice, butter, or creams.
Call an ambulance (1122) immediately if bleeding is severe, spurting, or does not stop.
Press a clean cloth or sterile gauze firmly and continuously directly on the wound.
Keep pressure on the wound and raise the injured limb if possible; do not remove soaked dressings.
Call an ambulance (1122) immediately and report the snake bite; do not wait for symptoms.
Keep the person still, calm, and the bitten limb below heart level; remove rings or tight items.
Do not cut, suck, ice, or apply a tourniquet, and do not try to catch the snake.
Call an ambulance (1122) immediately for chest pain, severe breathing trouble, collapse, or blue lips.
Sit the person upright, keep them still, loosen tight clothing, and reassure them.
If they become unresponsive and are not breathing normally, start CPR and use an AED if available.
